items.quote: Are there any hotels in the dataset that have a star rating of 5? If yes, how many hotels have a star rating of 5?
items.description: 答案檔 answer.txt 必須包含 @total_hotels[count] 鍵，值為 5 星飯店總數（非負整數）。

items.quote: Count only hotels that have a star rating exactly equal to 5.
items.description: 從 data/hotel_data.csv 重算 star_rating 等於 5 的列數，並與 answer.txt 的 @total_hotels 值比對。

items.quote: This count value should be a non-negative integer.
